tools.description: Kubernetes CLI for cluster management and application deployment
tools.usage:
kubectl get pods -A # List all pods
kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml # Apply configuration
kubectl logs -f pod-name # Follow logs
kubectl exec -it pod-name -- bash # Interactive shell
kubectl port-forward service/app 8080:80 # Port forwarding

tools.description: Kubernetes configuration management without templates using overlays
tools.usage:
kustomize build overlays/production # Build production config
kustomize build . | kubectl apply -f - # Apply kustomized config
kustomize edit set image app=myapp:v2 # Update image version
kustomize create --autodetect # Initialize kustomization
